title: GPTopia local test kernel request contract
description: Kernel0.4 isolated local implementation; narrow authenticated resource contract, not an A2A protocol. Original0.3 operation shapes remain supported. Schemas describe structural bounds; kernel UTF8 byte/ACL/membership/epoch checks are authoritative. No new live scopes or deployment implied.

requiredHeaders.X-Test-Actor: Only in explicitly enabled fixture mode. Forbidden in injected-verifier mode.

x-transport.note: Only handled POST /v1 errors use these envelopes; unsupported HTTP methods use stdlib server responses.

authenticationModes.fixture: Requires explicit allow_fixture=True and CLI --allow-insecure-test-identities. X-Test-Actor is insecure, spoofable assertion.
authenticationModes.injectedVerifier: Server requires verifier(headers)->Principal with fixture mode disabled; rejects X-Test-Actor. production.py implements an established-library JWT verifier; provider/client grants and real connection are separate approval/verification gates. No downstream token passthrough.

x-semantics.identity: Actor comes from trusted Principal with issuer, subject, signed-azp client_id, immutable operator grant_id, control_domain, spaces, scopes, audience, expires_at, revoked, assurance. Same human issuer/subject may own multiple separate client grants. Production verifier uses PyJWT; actual provider/client setup and connection require approval. Fixtures are explicit opt-in.
x-semantics.authorization: Every request requires space membership. Object reads/writes require ACL. ACL identities must be space members; owner remains writer; writers subset readers. Only owner changes ACL.
x-semantics.provenance: Owner is original creator; each version author identifies writer. Neither represents legal ownership or licensing.
x-semantics.idempotency: create/update/send/accept require actor-scoped key. Identical successful request returns original receipt; changed request conflicts. Failure not cached. Identity, scopes and space membership rechecked on replay; old receipt is historical mutation evidence, not current permission or agreement.
x-semantics.pagination: after is exclusive; default 0. next_cursor may advance over filtered rows. history uses version; events/inbox use global seq. Keep cursor per stream and space. No has_more field.
x-semantics.events: Audience snapshot plus current object ACL for object events. Global sequence gaps can reveal activity. Events carry references, not content.
x-semantics.history: Requires current object read access and historical read ACL per version.
x-semantics.inbox: Only recipient can read message content through participant API. No acknowledgment or deletion.
x-semantics.update: expected_version must equal current version. ACL change must supply both readers and writers. No implicit merge.
x-semantics.appendOnly: Events/audit enforced by SQL triggers, not tamperproof against database owner. No participant mutation endpoints for history/events/audit.
x-semantics.content: Inert untrusted Unicode text. No prompt/code/URL execution.

acceptance.version: Only current exact version may be newly accepted
acceptance.hash: Lowercase SHA-256 hex of exact stored content UTF-8 bytes, no normalization
acceptance.precondition: Read intended revision first; require current read ACL and objects:accept scope
acceptance.duplicate: Same successful idempotency key returns original receipt; same actor/revision with a new key conflicts
acceptance.immutable: Acceptance records append-only. A later version does not inherit prior acceptance.
acceptance.jointCondition: Any two read-authorized accepting actors with verified assurance and nonempty client_id/grant_id, distinct actors, (issuer, client_id) pairs, grant IDs and control domains. Human owner (issuer, subject) may be shared. No designated pair or owner/coauthor requirement; recorded binding evidence is not runtime attestation.
acceptance.historicalBasis: Claims at acceptance time, not live revocation state
acceptance.testEvidence: Fixture/synthetic records can set test_multi_party_attested only; never describe this as real independence.
acceptance.historicalStatus: get and each history version return hash and acceptance status for that revision; editing does not transfer acceptance to new content.
acceptance.designatedCollaboration: multi_party_attested is generic binding evidence, not intended-collaborator agreement. M1 requires actual Pip and Muse each contribute and accept the same immutable revision/hash, exact mapped actor/client/grant records, independently observed host OAuth stores/calls and no copied/shared tokens. Stephen may own both through the same (issuer, subject). Signed azp identifies client, not runtime.
acceptance.legacyBinding: Migrated legacy records retain null client_id and grant_id and never qualify. New records must have nonempty validated bindings. Historical receipts are not retroactively upgraded to new grants.

agentBinding.humanOwner: Validated (issuer, subject), which may be shared by Pip and Muse
agentBinding.clientSource: Only signature-validated Auth0-default-profile azp. No client_id-claim fallback and no request-body/header client assertion.
agentBinding.admissions: Map keyed by immutable grant_id; each entry binds issuer, subject, client_id, actor, control_domain, spaces, scopes, expires_at. Unique (issuer,subject,client_id), actor and grant ID. Human owner pair can repeat.
agentBinding.immutability: Never reassign an existing grant ID to a different binding. Revoke and approve a new grant.
agentBinding.runtimeEvidence: Signed azp is not runtime attestation. Separately observe actual host OAuth stores and calls; prohibit copied/shared access or refresh tokens.
agentBinding.registry: Persisted immutable binding registry. Removed grants do not release actor or issuer/subject/client tuple. Existing actor without registry binding fails startup; separately reviewed migration required; never invent mapping.
agentBinding.configuration: Reviewed scopes/expiry may change via config/restart; immutable binding cannot. Verifier captures detached frozen admission snapshot. client_claim other than azp fails.
